questions.prompt: Which ancient civilisation is credited with inventing concrete used in domes and aqueducts?
questions.fact: Their seawater harbour concrete grows stronger over time, a property modern cement does not share.

questions.prompt: Which subatomic particle has no electric charge?
questions.fact: Outside an atomic nucleus one survives only about fifteen minutes before decaying into other particles.

questions.prompt: Which competition is contested by the best golfers of Europe and the United States?
questions.fact: It was originally Britain against the United States. Continental Europe was added in 1979 to make it competitive.

questions.prompt: Which actor played the Joker in the 2008 film The Dark Knight?
questions.fact: He kept a diary in character during filming, and won a posthumous Academy Award for the performance.

questions.prompt: Which island is divided between Haiti and the Dominican Republic?
questions.fact: The border is visible from orbit, with dense forest on one side and cleared land on the other.

questions.prompt: Who wrote The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy?
questions.fact: It started as a radio series, and he was famously so late with deadlines that publishers locked him in a hotel to finish one book.

questions.prompt: Which technology allows contactless card payments?
questions.fact: Its range is a few centimetres by design, since being hard to intercept is the point rather than a limitation.
